P-10  ·  embedded, electrical

Thermistor Thermometer

Built from first principles to understand the whole chain — thermistor, divider, ADC, linearisation — landing at ±0.1 °C.

Sheet
P-10
Year
2023
Discipline
embedded, electrical
ArduinoThermistorVoltage divider
Problem
Understanding how an electronic thermometer actually works, end to end.
Scope
Build one from a thermistor, a voltage divider and an Arduino.
Role
Wiring diagram, Arduino firmware, breadboard assembly, and debugging for accuracy.
Result
A working thermometer reading accurate to ±0.1 °C.
Next pass
Rework with a potentiometer for calibration, then move to a PCB for a portable version.
